hypotheses.title: idiosyncratic_momentum_residual_zscore
hypotheses.hypothesis: Stocks exhibiting high residual momentum (stock return minus beta-adjusted index return) exhibit higher 21-day forward returns than stocks with high factor-driven momentum
hypotheses.signal_definition: For AAPL, MSFT, etc., compute 60-day rolling beta relative to SPY; calculate residual return = R_i - (Beta_i * R_market); compute z-score of residual return over 252-day window
data_required: prices_daily (SPY, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META, NVDA, TSLA, AMD)
hypotheses.expected_edge: Higher Information Ratio by filtering out beta-driven momentum
hypotheses.compute_approach: 1) Compute 60d rolling beta for each ticker vs SPY, 2) Calculate daily residual returns, 3) Compute 252d rolling z-score of residuals, 4) Rank stocks by z-score, 5) Backtest long top decile
hypotheses.validation_plan: Compare Sharpe of 'Residual Momentum' vs 'Raw Momentum' (simple 12m momentum) using 21d forward returns

hypotheses.title: credit_spread_extreme_expansion_zscore
hypotheses.hypothesis: Extreme expansion in high-yield credit spreads (hy_ig_spread) acts as a leading indicator for equity volatility expansion and negative returns
hypotheses.signal_definition: Compute 252-day rolling z-score of the hy_ig_spread macro signal; trigger signal when z-score > 2.0
hypotheses.expected_relationship: negative correlation with 5d/10d forward SPY returns
hypotheses.expected_edge: Detection of systemic liquidity/risk-off regime shifts
hypotheses.compute_approach: 1) Query hy_ig_spread, 2) Compute 252d rolling z-score, 3) Identify periods where z > 2, 4) Measure SPY returns and VIX levels during these periods
hypotheses.validation_plan: Test predictive power of spread z-score on SPY 5d and 21d forward returns; check for regime-dependent efficacy

hypotheses.title: tax_day_volatility_clustering
hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased realized volatility in SPY during the 5 trading days preceding April 15th predicts a negative return shock on April 15th-20th
hypotheses.signal_definition: Calculate 5-day rolling standard deviation of SPY daily returns; identify windows where this value is > 1.5x the 60-day average; measure SPY returns for the subsequent 5 days
hypotheses.compute_approach: 1) Query SPY daily returns, 2) Compute 5d rolling std dev, 3) Compute 60d rolling mean of that std dev, 4) Identify 'high vol' periods around April 15, 5) Regress forward 5d returns against signal
hypotheses.validation_plan: Test correlation with 5d/10d forward SPY returns specifically in the April window vs non-April windows

hypotheses.title: volatility_feature_roc_transformation
hypotheses.hypothesis: The rate of change (ROC) of the IV skew (difference between OTM and ATM IV) is a more predictive feature for price direction than the absolute IV level
hypotheses.signal_definition: Compute IV_skew = IV(25d_OTM) - IV(ATM); compute 5-day ROC of IV_skew; z-score the ROC against a 60-day window
hypotheses.expected_relationship: negative correlation with 5d forward SPY returns when ROC is positive
hypotheses.expected_edge: Capturing rapid shifts in dealer hedging demand
hypotheses.compute_approach: 1) Extract IV for ATM and 25d OTM strikes from options_eod, 2) Calculate IV_skew, 3) Compute 5d ROC of skew, 4) Z-score the ROC over 60d
hypotheses.validation_plan: Test if ROC(skew) z-score has higher mutual information with 5d SPY returns than absolute IV or absolute skew

hypotheses.title: cross_asset_momentum_stacking_zscore
hypotheses.hypothesis: A stacked momentum signal combining ES=F (Equity), NQ=F (Tech), and RB=F (Energy/Commodity) reduces drawdown compared to single-asset momentum
hypotheses.signal_definition: Compute 21d momentum for ES=F, NQ=F, and RB=F; compute the z-score of the sum of these momentum components; weight by inverse volatility
hypotheses.expected_relationship: positive correlation with 21d forward aggregate return
hypotheses.expected_edge: Reduced volatility and improved Sortino ratio via diversification of momentum sources
hypotheses.compute_approach: 1) Compute 21d returns for all three assets, 2) Compute 60d rolling volatility for each, 3) Create weighted sum: Sum(Return_i / Vol_i), 4) Z-score the resulting aggregate signal
hypotheses.validation_plan: Compare the Sharpe ratio of the 'Stacked Momentum' signal against a 'Pure Equity Momentum' (ES=F only) signal
